expect.query: Polícia Nacional de Timor Leste Comando Município de Dili

c139032240.notes: Caicoli, Dili. Blue name board on the compound wall, small in the frame and slightly soft. No accent is discernible on MUNICIPIO. The phone number after 'Tel :' looks like 3311380 but is too blurred to confirm, so it is left out. Badge above reads 'POLICIA NACIONAL' (tiny). A parked SUV with plate in the foreground is incidental, not the subject.

c141518502.notes: Caicoli, Dili. Raised metal letters over the gate of the PNTL General Command; the upper line has no 'DE' and is crossed by overhead cables (the M of TIMOR is stylised and can read as 'IVI'). Shadows double the letter outlines. Small number plate '38' on the gate pillar.

c141518503.reason: near-duplicate of c141518502 (same PNTL Comando Geral gate sign, slightly wider view)

c140596547.notes: Caicoli, Dili. Yellow name board between white posts, small in a wide shady photo (fence and tree in the foreground). The address strip is small; its first word is '1º Andar' (the ordinal mark is tiny), and the accents in Edifício/Mártires/Pátria are absent on the sign. Parked cars incidental.
